description: This file defines the Offset class which implements the OFFSET function similar to Excel's OFFSET. It provides functionality to return a cell or range of cells offset from a reference cell, handling calculation of new cell references based on input parameters. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Offset
classes.description: Provides implementation for the Excel OFFSET function, calculating relative cell ranges based on input parameters.

methods.name: OFFSET
methods.description: Main method to compute the cell or range of cells offset from a given reference cell based on parameters including number of rows, columns, height, and width.

methods.name: extractRequiredCells
methods.description: Extracts the specified cell range from the worksheet.

methods.name: extractWorksheet
methods.description: Identifies and retrieves the worksheet object for a given cell address, supporting sheet references.

methods.name: assessCellAddress
methods.description: Evaluates and expands named ranges or references in the cell address string.

methods.name: adjustEndCellColumnForWidth
methods.description: Calculates the end column index based on the width parameter.

methods.name: adustEndCellRowForHeight
methods.description: Calculates the end row index based on the height parameter.
